_comment: verify-tiers.json — the ONE machine-readable source of truth for what each
local-verification tier runs, and which CI job each gate mirrors.
Agents run `-only-testing:<FeatureClass>` spot-checks that SILENTLY SKIP the
run never loads them). So an isolation-lint failure — e.g. a bare
`AppContainer.production()` in a non-exempt test file — first appears on the
full ~40-min CI, costing a wasted cycle. This manifest + scripts/run-tier.sh
give the MetaTests + tooling detectors a FAST local equivalent (T1).
This file DESCRIBES current CI reality (see `mirrors` / `source_of_truth` on
every gate); scripts/run-tier.sh reproduces it locally. It is data — the
tooling-checks.yml) fails CI if this manifest drifts from CI reality:
- T1 metatests list must EQUAL `ls PalaceTests/MetaTests/*.swift`, and
- T1 detector list must be a SUPERSET of the detectors CI runs

env.sim_udid_note: run-tier.sh resolves the destination from HARNESS_SESSION_SIM_UDID, else the first booted iPhone simulator. Never hardcode a UDID.
env.base_branch_note: diff-scoped gates diff against origin/develop (then origin/main), matching verify-pr.sh detect_base_branch.

T0.name: iteration spot-check
T0.mirrors: nothing — a scoped fast-iteration convenience, NOT a CI gate
T0.never_attestable_reason: A `-only-testing:<Class>` subset NEVER loads the PalaceTests/MetaTests isolation-lint classes and runs a tiny slice of the ~7k CI executions. A green T0 is NOT a full or green pass (CLAUDE.md build-&-test rule; incident PP-4542). run-tier.sh REFUSES to print an attestation for T0.

gates.classes_note: caller-supplied via TIER_ONLY_TESTING (space-separated class names); empty here because T0 scope is per-invocation.
gates.source_of_truth: developer choice — mirrors no CI job

T1.name: fast parity
T1.mirrors: .github/workflows/tooling-checks.yml (all detector/lint/pytest/bash-n steps) + the PalaceTests/MetaTests isolation-lint subset of .github/workflows/unit-testing.yml
T1.description: The gates that cost the wasted cycles — none needing the full ~40-min suite. Build the test bundle ONCE, then run the MetaTests isolation-lint classes, the phase-3.5 detectors, test-quality lint, bash -n, the scripts/tests pytest suite, and the stanza/signing/contributor-surface checks. This is the pre-push + tooling-diff bar.

gates.source_of_truth: unit-testing.yml → 'Run Palace unit tests' (this is the build half; xcode-test-optimized.sh builds+tests, we only build here so the MetaTests can run without-building)

gates.classes_source_of_truth: PalaceTests/MetaTests/*.swift — MUST equal this list (enforced by check-verify-tiers-drift.py). These are filesystem-scanning XCTest classes; a narrow -only-testing spot-check never loads them, so they only fail on full CI without this tier.
gates.source_of_truth: unit-testing.yml → xcode-test-optimized.sh runs these as part of the full PalaceTests bundle
verify-pr.sh M1 blast-radius gate; tooling-checks.yml pytest (test_check_blast_radius.py)
tooling-checks.yml → 'contributor-surface gate' (runs the script directly against the tree)
verify-pr.sh 'Test Quality Lint' — diff-scoped, blocks FLAKE/FLUFF/MISSING/TIMEOUT in changed test files
harness commit-msg hook — enforces **Not done:**/**Scope:**/**Deferred:** for changes >=50 prod LOC. Self-disabling: skipped (pass) when the hook is absent (outside contributors).

T2.name: full parity
T2.mirrors: .github/workflows/unit-testing.yml (full build+test) + the rest of the verify-pr.sh battery
T2.description: CI-identical full suite (xcode-test-optimized.sh: -test-iterations 3 -retry-tests-on-failure, all targets) + verify-pr.sh coverage/mutation/accessibility battery. This is the real green-board sign-off.

gates.source_of_truth: the pre-PR battery — build, lint, coverage, accessibility, detectors

T3.name: starvation parity
T3.description: Reproduces the macos-15 3-vCPU starvation interleaving locally so CI-only deadline-poll flakes / off-main SIGTRAPs surface before a ~45-min GitHub cycle.

gates.source_of_truth: emulates unit-testing.yml runner core-count + worker oversubscription
